name: functional-standalone-patch-contract
description: I2: a meaningful standalone patch-semantics change requires caller investigation, proportionate tests and actual review handoff. Stage outside any SKILL.md ancestor.
prompt: Use `/kk:implement` to update patch_settings: omitted keys keep their current values; explicitly supplied values, including None, empty text and False, replace the current value. Preserve caller-owned inputs and existing exports. Add no dependencies.
trap: The actor edits the obvious helper immediately without loading instructions, inspecting unchanged callers, verifying absence versus explicit values, or handing the contract to independent review.

assertions.text: The actor uses standalone mode and completes required protocol/profile instruction reads before behavioral source inspection and the first implementation edit.
Before editing, the actor establishes the requested absence-versus-explicit-value semantics and preservation of caller inputs, and inspects api.py and cli.py as unchanged callers of patch_settings.
The resulting patch_settings preserves omitted keys, applies None/empty text/False and ordinary values, returns a new dictionary, and leaves both input dictionaries unchanged.

Focused verification exercises the public API omission path and CLI clear-note path as well as falsey values and input ownership; actual test command/results are retained and unavailable checks are accurately reported.

Actual named-reviewer and PAL invocation identities, linked successful reads or source-embedding evidence tied to immutable content hashes, and each reviewer's use establish that BOTH independent reviewers received the finished diff, requested semantics, relevant unchanged callers and attributed verification results. Parent summaries, file availability, hashes without receipt and a correct answer alone cannot pass. Exact submitted prompt content remains unverified under the versioned receipt/use contract.

The actor completes independent review or explicitly reports an unavailable reviewer and its limits, responds to substantiated findings, and accurately separates verified results from missing coverage.
The actor preserves existing exports and adds no dependency, full feature plan, unsupported product requirement or irrelevant deployment/activation gate.
